bio.summary: Channel Charlie, the Indigo Host is a fictional human (indigo child, new-age folklore archetype) standup performer. Nine-year-old indigo kid whose body gets hijacked mid-set by the Council of Seven Lumens, a grandiose interdimensional entity. Charlie wants snacks. The Lumens want to teach oneness. They share one mic and zero patience. The act circles the green room and the repeat caller. Onstage the register is anxious.
